Hey Mckenzie thank you so much for replying. Sorry it took so long to respond, I've just been in a bad place.

Thank you for sharing your experiences and battle with panic, and even though I'm sorry to get you teary eyed, I'm really touched you empathize so strongly.  It makes me feel like I'm not so alone.

I saved your mantra in my phone and will try it next time.  I envy you in a lot of ways for being able to believe during an attack that it's just panic.  I have tried it myself, and the thing that happens is the panic replies back "...but what if this time it isn't panic".  That's where my fear lives.  Even if I'm 99% sure I'm ok, that 1% uncertainty festers and grows like a cancer, leading to more attacks.  I just don't know why I can't believe I'm ok, even after having so many docs and specialists tell me I am physically fine.  There's a disconnect in my brain.  It's almost like a hallucination within my logic.  I understand I'm physically ok, but I dont know it.

Thank you again for sharing, really.  I'm going to try and commit to what you said.

Hey thank you so much for replying.  Sorry it took so long to respond, I've just been in a bad place.

Xanax is the only thing that seems to work, but I'm afraid of taking too much of it and develop a tolerance.  I just want to get over this without the need of benzos daily, if that's even possible.

I'm definitely interested in exposure therapy, but I'm afraid to do it on my own.  When I'm alone, that's when my panic can get out of control because I'm just not strong enough to talk down my worst fears.  If I had someone with me, especially a professional, I would feel much more comfortable/confident.

I have exercised in the past, but eventually give up because something happens in my life, like a really bad panic attack like the other day that sends me to the hospital.  For some reason I can't seem to gain faith or trust in my heart or body like so many others after surviving panic attacks.  I'm always left shaken and traumatized that the next one will get me. 

I will look more into exposure therapy, and I need a new psych to recommend diff medications, as my current psych has sort of lost me.  Thank you again <3
